summary: software-programmable radio, voice and data beyond line of sight (the CONECT upgrade)

frequency_min_hz.note: Standard AN/ARC-210 VHF/UHF tuning floor (30 MHz, Collins Aerospace published family range)

frequency_max_hz.note: Standard AN/ARC-210 VHF/UHF tuning ceiling (512 MHz)

tx_power_w.note: Nominal airborne VHF/UHF AM/FM/HAVE QUICK transceiver RF output (~15-25 W)

channel_bandwidth_hz.note: Standard 25 kHz VHF/UHF voice/data channel spacing

processing_gain_db.note: Assumed HAVE QUICK / SINCGARS modest hop anti-jam processing margin (waveform dependent)

jam_threshold_j_to_n_db.note: Assumed effective post-processing J/N voice/data link-denial threshold

antenna_gain_dbi.note: Nominal omnidirectional VHF/UHF blade antenna gain

iff_capable.note: VHF/UHF voice/data radio without IFF interrogator

iff_mode5.note: VHF/UHF voice/data radio without Mode 5 IFF
